questions.question: Due to decrease in manpower, the production in a factory decreases by 10%. By what percentage should the working hours be increased to restore the original production?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a value decreases by R%, the required percentage increase to restore the original value is given by the formula:

Required Increase % = [R ÷ (100 − R)] × 100

Here, the decrease in manpower R = 10%.

⇒ Required Increase = [10 ÷ (100 − 10)] × 100

⇒ (10 ÷ 90) × 100 = 100 ÷ 9 = 11 ¹/₉%

**∴ The correct answer is 11 ¹/₉%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Decrease in manpower and subsequent production = 10%

 
 
 100
 Original
 
 
 
 90
 Decreased

 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 

 −10%

 
 

 + Increase %
 
 
 Required Increase = 10 ÷ 90 × 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the original production be 100 units based on the initial manpower and working hours.

⇒ Due to a 10% decrease in manpower, the new production drops to 100 − 10 = 90 units.

⇒ To restore the original production (100 units) with the current reduced manpower, the working hours must compensate for the 10-unit deficit.

⇒ The required increase must be calculated on the new production base (90 units).

⇒ Required percentage increase = (Increase ÷ New Base) × 100

⇒ Required percentage increase = (10 ÷ 90) × 100

⇒ Required percentage increase = 100 ÷ 9 = 11 ¹/₉%

**∴ The correct answer is 11 ¹/₉%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product Constancy Rule (A × B = Constant)

When the product of two variables is constant (e.g., Manpower × Working Hours = Total Production), an increase of 1/x in one variable requires a decrease of 1/(x+1) in the other to maintain the product. Conversely, a decrease of 1/x requires an increase of 1/(x−1).

Base Change Concept in Percentage

If Quantity A is R% less than Quantity B, then B is [R ÷ (100 − R)] × 100% more than A. This happens because the reference base changes from B to A.

questions.question: AB is parallel to CD. A transversal PQ intersects AB and CD at E and F, respectively, and ∠PEB = 42°. G is a point between AB and CD such that ∠BEG = 21° and ∠GFE = 34°. What is the measure of ∠EGF?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AB is parallel to CD.

A transversal PQ intersects AB and CD at E and F, respectively.

∠PEB = 42º

G is a point between AB and CD such that:

∠BEG = 21º

∠GFE = 34º

Concept used:

Sum of angles on a straight line is 180o.

Sum of all angles of a triangle is 180o.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96a986d27c9fc484cd9d5724d031efea62c00ee5992b45c0a5c2b57f3a7a35e9.png] 

⇒ ∠PEB + ∠BEG + ∠FEG = 180o

⇒ 42o + 21o + ∠FEG = 180o

⇒ ∠FEG = 117o

Now , In triangle EGF,

∠GFE + ∠EGF + ∠FEG = 180

⇒ 34o + ∠EGF + 117o = 180o 

⇒ ∠EGF = 180o - 117o - 34o 

⇒ ∠EGF = 29o 

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by both 27 and 19?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

We need to find which of the following numbers is divisible by both 27 and 19.

**Formula used:**

A number is divisible by two numbers if it is divisible by their Least Common Multiple (LCM).

LCM(27, 19) = 27 × 19 (since 27 and 19 are coprime).

**Calculations:**

LCM = 27 × 19

⇒ LCM = 513

Now check divisibility of each option by 513:

1) 33488 ÷ 513 = 65.28 (not divisible)

2) 35691 ÷ 513 = 69.56 (not divisible)

3) 34962 ÷ 513 = 68.14 (not divisible)

4) 34371 ÷ 513 = 67 (divisible)

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question: "A man has to cover a distance of 222 km in 14 hours. If he covers two-third of this distance in 3/7 of the time, then what should his speed (in km/hr) be to cover the remaining distance?"
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total Distance = 222 km

Total Time = 14 hours

Distance covered in (3)/(7) of time = (2)/(3) of distance

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

Distance for first part = (2)/(3) times 222 = 148 km

Time for first part = (3)/(7) times 14 = 6 hours

Remaining distance = 222 - 148 = 74 km

Remaining time = 14 - 6 = 8 hours

Required speed = 74 ÷ 8 = 9.25 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 9.25 km/hr.**

questions.question: When x is added to each of 29, 31, 7 and 8, then the numbers so obtained, in this order, are in proportion. Then, if 5x : y :: y : (2x-3), and y > 0, what is the value of y?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers 29, 31, 7, and 8 are in proportion when x is added to each.

5x : y :: y : (2x - 3) and y > 0

**Formula used:**

If a, b, c, d are in proportion, then a/b = c/d.

For ratio, if a : b :: c : d, then a × d = b × c.

**Calculations:**

Numbers in proportion:

(29 + x) / (31 + x) = (7 + x) / (8 + x)

⇒ (29 + x) × (8 + x) = (31 + x) × (7 + x)

⇒ 232 + 29x + 8x + x² = 217 + 31x + 7x + x²

⇒ 232 + 37x = 217 + 38x

⇒ x = 15

Solve for y:

5x : y :: y : (2x - 3)

⇒ 5x × (2x - 3) = y × y

⇒ 5 × 15 × (2 × 15 - 3) = y²

⇒ 75 × (30 - 3) = y²

⇒ 75 × 27 = y²

⇒ 2025 = y²

⇒ y = √2025 = 45

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 63 hours, B and C together can do it in 42 hours, while A and C together can do it in 27 hours. How long (in hours) will B alone take to do it?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(63, 42, 27) = 378 units.

Efficiencies: A = 6, B + C = 9, and A + C = 14.

Efficiency of C = (A + C) − A = 14 − 6 = 8.

Efficiency of B = (B + C) − C = 9 − 8 = 1.

Time taken by B = Total work ÷ B's efficiency = 378 ÷ 1 = 378 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 378 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A = 63 hours

Time taken by B and C together = 42 hours

Time taken by A and C together = 27 hours

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of given time

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

Time = Total Work ÷ Efficiency

 
 

 **Person**
 **Hours**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A
 63
 378
 6
 
 

 B + C
 42
 9
 
 

 A + C
 27
 14
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of A = 6 units/hour

⇒ Efficiency of A + C = 14 units/hour

⇒ Efficiency of C = 14 − 6 = 8 units/hour

⇒ Efficiency of B + C = 9 units/hour

⇒ Efficiency of B = 9 − 8 = 1 unit/hour

⇒ Time taken by B alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of B

⇒ Time taken by B alone = 378 ÷ 1 = 378 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 378 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work & Efficiency Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken. Total Work = Efficiency × Time. The LCM method simplifies fractional calculations by assigning whole numbers to the total assumed work.

Work & Wages

Wages are always distributed in proportion to the total work done by each individual. If workers work for the same number of days, the wages are distributed directly in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Pipes & Cisterns

This concept is exactly the same as Time & Work. Inlet pipes have a positive efficiency as they fill the tank, while outlet pipes or leaks have a negative efficiency as they empty the tank.
</p

questions.question: On selling a bed at ₹8,845, the value of gain is 25% more than the value of loss incurred on selling it at ₹1,987. In order to gain 20%, find the selling price (in ₹).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price in gain case = ₹8845

Selling Price in loss case = ₹1987

Gain = 25% more than Loss

**Formula used:**

Gain = SP - CP

Loss = CP - SP

If Gain = Loss + 25% of Loss ⇒ Gain = 1.25 × Loss

**Calculations:**

Let CP = x

⇒ Gain = 8845 − x

⇒ Loss = x − 1987

⇒ 8845 − x = 1.25 × (x − 1987)

⇒ 8845 − x = 1.25x − 2483.75

⇒ 8845 + 2483.75 = 1.25x + x

⇒ 11328.75 = 2.25x

⇒ x = 11328.75 ÷ 2.25 = 5035

Now, to gain 20%:

SP = 120% of CP = 1.2 × 5035 = ₹6042

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6042**

questions.question: The area of a square is 2304 cm². Its perimeter is equal to the perimeter of a regular hexagon. what is the are (in cm²) of the hexagon?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of square = 2304 cm²

Perimeter of square = Perimeter of regular hexagon

**Formula used:**

Side of square = √Area

Perimeter of square = 4 × side

Perimeter of hexagon = 6 × side

Area of regular hexagon = frac{3sqrt{3}}{2} times {side}²

**Calculation:**

Side of square = √2304 = 48 cm

Perimeter of square = 4 × 48 = 192 cm

Perimeter of hexagon = 192 cm

⇒ Side of hexagon = 192 ÷ 6 = 32 cm

Area of hexagon = frac{3sqrt{3}}{2} times 32²

= frac{3sqrt{3}}{2} times 1024

= 1536sqrt{3} cm²

**∴ The area of the hexagon is 1536sqrt{3} cm².**

questions.question: The population of a village was 1,00,000. It increased by 5% in the first year and increased by 20% in the second year. Its population after two years is _______.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial Population = 1,00,000

Increase in 1st year = 5%

Increase in 2nd year = 20%

**Formula used:**

Population after n years = Initial Population × (1 + Rate₁/100) × (1 + Rate₂/100)

**Calculations:**

Population after 1st year = 1,00,000 × (1 + 5/100)

⇒ Population after 1st year = 1,00,000 × 1.05 = 1,05,000

Population after 2nd year = 1,05,000 × (1 + 20/100)

⇒ Population after 2nd year = 1,05,000 × 1.20 = 1,26,000

** The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question: The difference between the simple interest and the compound interest, compounded annually, on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 10% per annum is ₹407. Find the sum [rounded off to the nearest integer].
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective CI rate for 2 years = 10% + 10% + (10 × 10) ÷ 100% = 21%

Effective SI rate for 2 years = 10% × 2 = 20%

Difference in interest rates = 21% − 20% = 1%

Given 1% of Principal = ₹407

⇒ Principal = 407 × 100 = 40700

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40,700.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference between compound interest and simple interest (D) = ₹407

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time period (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years: D = P × (R ÷ 100)²

 1% of P = ₹407

**Calculations:**

⇒ D = P × (R ÷ 100)²

⇒ 407 = P × (10 ÷ 100)²

⇒ 407 = P × (1 ÷ 10)²

⇒ 407 = P × (1 ÷ 100)

⇒ P = 407 × 100

⇒ P = 40700

**∴ The correct answer is ₹40,700.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference for 3 Years

The difference between compound interest and simple interest on a sum for 3 years is calculated using the formula: D = P × (R ÷ 100)² × (3 + R ÷ 100).

Effective Rate Method

For 2 years, compound interest can be directly computed using the successive percentage change formula: CI% = X + Y + (XY ÷ 100)%.

Half-Yearly Compounding

When compound interest is applied half-yearly, the annual rate of interest is halved (R ÷ 2) and the number of time periods is doubled (2T).

Rule of 72

To quickly estimate the number of years required to double a principal sum at a given compound interest rate, you can use the formula: T ≈ 72 ÷ R.

Discount% = (58.61 ÷ 568) × 100 = 10.32%

**∴ The correct answer is 10.32%**

questions.question: A boat takes 83 minutes to go 33.2 km upstream. The ratio of the speed of the boat in still water to that of the stream is 8 : 5. How much total time (in hours) will the boat take to go 47.1 km upstream and 55.9 km downstream?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time to cover 33.2 km upstream = 83 minutes = 83 ÷ 60 = 1.383 hours

Ratio of boat speed to stream speed = 8 : 5

Find total time for: 47.1 km upstream + 55.9 km downstream

**Formula used:**

Upstream speed = B − S

Downstream speed = B + S

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

Let boat speed = 8x, stream speed = 5x

⇒ Upstream speed = 8x − 5x = 3x

⇒ 33.2 ÷ 3x = 1.383

⇒ 3x = 33.2 ÷ 1.383 = 24
